spanish: Honra a tu padre y a tu madre, a fin de que se alarguen tus días sobre el suelo que Jehová tu Dios te da.
grammarChanges: Replaced the bare gerund 'dando' with the finite present 'da', fronting the dative as the clitic 'te' ('te da'), so the qal active participle completes the relative-clause predicate; subject (Jehová tu Dios) and recipient unchanged.
readerNote: Completed the participle's predicate with the simple present 'te da' rather than the periphrastic 'te está dando'; 'se alarguen' was left unchanged since it already renders the intransitive hiphil with plural días as subject, adding no causer or object.
